summary: TOMI Environmental Solutions filed an 8-K to announce the release of an investor presentation on May 7, 2026. The filing contains no material definitive agreement, no transaction, no activist campaign, no strategic review, no tender offer, no going-private event, no capital return, no spin-off, no rights offering, no restructuring, no liquidation, no delisting, no issuer tender, no deal termination, no SPAC event, and no management change. It is simply a routine communication of an investor presentation. Therefore, this filing does not constitute a special situation. No deal terms are applicable.
